nodes.text: explore 0 (enterprise-data-analyst 0): Pair owner for AAA offerings course_id=1 and course_id=2. Request the two offerings' page 1 together in one native-parallel response with canvas_list_student_submissions(course_id=<id>, student_ids=["all"], grouped=false, page=1, per_page=100), then issue both offerings' remaining literal pages revealed by total_pages together in native-parallel batches and verify every page identity. Use literal row.id as submission identity, retain only rows with a numeric score, group them by user_id, compute each included student's mean over all scored submissions, and exclude students with none. Write one compact JSON containing the two complete per-student mean arrays, grade-band counts, student counts, score sums, page identities, submission IDs/counts and duplicate controls; read it back; and return only path/hash and those controls. Do not return raw submissions in chat or use final_score/current_score in place of submission.score.
